lines.en: : Okayokay! Nowiss Senpai’s *hic* turn! Dare meto...kissyou! I dareyou to...dareme todo that!
: Imani, I’m okay with reminding you every five minutes since we’re friends and threesome partners, but we’re playing a different game tonight. Which means you can’t keep daring Akira to do things.
: Sure I can! We’reall adulllss herean all! Issupto him if he’s wanna...annsser thingsthough!
: I feel like if we don’t cut her off soon, I’m going to wind up having sex with Rika again.
: So Imani gets drunk and Rika’s the one you wind up sleeping with? How does that work?
: Well, last time it involved Rika getting drunk as well. This time, I imagine it will just be on account of her wanting my penis inside of her.
: Gross.
: Lessave a *hic* foursssome! It’ll be jusslike tha one time butssss Rika now asstead of Osako...
: Noooo! Let’s keep playing the game! Akira needs to do two truths and a lie now!
: Isn’t it Wakana’s turn, though? We’re going counter clockwise, aren’t we?
: Oh, true. Just hers are never fun so I forgot she was even playing.
: I’ll have you know I am perfectly capable of being fun. It’s just difficult to do without restraints.
: I brought some if you need them. I always have handcuffs in my travel bag. It’s less for sex and more just because I’ve always wanted to conduct a citizen’s arrest, though.
: Two truths and a lie then? I-
: Ah-ah-ah! Not just any truths and lies, though. Imani made us guess between the Pokemon she’d sleep with, so you need to match those vibes at the very least.
: I was trying to before I was so rudely interrupted.
: I’m sure Rika’s probably still just sour from you doing nothing but naming various writers the last time we played this and making us guess which ones you don’t hate.
: Someone needs to take Stephen King’s computer anyway. His work is somehow even less consistent than your mood, Akira.
: Excuse me, but I’ve only had one mental breakdown today. That’s pretty good for a beach trip.
: Heywe still got timefor anotherr! Get naked and we can *hic* do somea that CFNM stuff!
: That does sound fun, I won’t lie.
: CFNM?
: You are the most fucking vanilla sexpest who has ever existed. Who even created you?
: I don’t remember.
: How convenient.
: Wakana, come on! Imani’s gonna pass out if you make us wait any longer!
: Huh? Who’s Imani? That- oh, I’m Imani! It’s me!
: Okay, but-
: DA DAAA. DAD ADADADA...IT’S ME. Youguyss know that song?
: Okay, but have it be known that I am only saying these things to both “match the vibe” and show Akira that I am cooler than him.
: Two truths and a lie. I lost my virginity in a bar, I once had sex in a classroom, and my single day orgasm record is ten.
: Okay, well that orgasm one’s a lie. No one can still keep track of their orgasm counter once it starts getting that high. Plus, I’ve heard stories from Osako. You’re a one and done kind of girl.
: No, I’m a “one and focus on pleasing my partner” kind of girl.
: Thasswhat guys say when theycan’t getit up anymore. Ain’that right, Senpaiii?
: I think the bar one is a lie, actually. You, I can see. But I don’t think Osako would have agreed to such a thing for  her first time.
: Who said she agreed to anything at all? Maybe I took advantage of her and didn’t give her room to resist whatsoever?
: Ten orgasms. Final answer. That one is the lie.
: Senpaaaaaiiiiiii...
: I thought we needed to decide as a group? I still think it’s the bar one.
: Overruled. I’m the only one who isn’t drunk right now, so I’m the only one who can think rationally.
: I’ve only had three beers.
: Lies. You’re at least halfway done with your fourth, so I’m rounding up.
: Still not enough to be drunk. Just because you’re trying to cut down on calories does not mean you can overrule my correctness.
: So which answer are you locking in? Ten orgasms or my virginity in a bar?
: Ten orgasms! Final answer.
: Bzzzzzzt. You lose.
: I fucking knew it. You should have listened to me, Rika. No one is better at imagining Wakana’s sex life than I am.
: Don’t get ahead of yourself, Arakawa. You’re wrong too. I did lose my virginity in a bar. On Christmalloween, actually. Care to take a guess what I was dressed as?
: Nothing. You aren’t fun enough for that.
: Well, at least you got that right.
: Wait, hold the fucking phone.
: Okay!

: Thanks, Imani. What do you mean you’ve never had sex in a classroom? You’re a teacher. And you went to college together with your long term partner. Classrooms are basically just giant beds in my experience.
: I’ve had sex near classrooms. Faculty rooms. Teacher’s lounge. Gymnasium. Gymnasium shower. The music room.
: My music room?! Is that why all of my girls are so horny?! You contaminated it with your hot goth pheromones! How could you?!
: Can I put this phone down now? I wanna drink some more.
: Yes, Imani. You can put the phone down. Do you need another drink too?
: Yespleaseee!
: Don’t encourage her. Any more and she’s going to wind up in the hospital before the beach trip ends and then Akira is never going to visit her and it will form a rift in their relationship.
: You’ve definitely had sex in a classroom. Those were all lies.
: Just because you’ve likely imagined it a thousand times does not make it true.
: Sorry. I have a hard time telling the difference sometimes.
: Regardless, it’s your turn now, Arakawa. Which I believe means you must now “match the vibes” as well.
: Just hopefully in a way that will not depress all of us since your sexual background is darker than The Cask of Amontillado.
: Two truths and a lie. I’ve had sex with Imani, I’ve had sex with Rika, and I’ve had sex with you.
: I’m going to drown you in the ocean.
: That just means you think I’m cute.
: Come on, Akira. Give us a real one! Make us guess which one of us you’ve yanked it to the most or something.
: That sounds hard to do in the format of this game’s prompts. I’ll just come up with something else.
: We all know it’s me anyway. I’m the one he can’t touch.
: Two truths and a lie. I’ve masturbated in my office, I don’t own any sex toys, and I have never had sex in a classroom.
: You bitch. You just stole one of mine.
: Not owning any sex toys in 2020 is crazy. Even when you have one built into your hand.
: Issclearly notthat one sinceI’m Senpai’s sextoy.
: Wait, yeah. Clarify. Does Imani count as a sex toy?
: I am not counting her as a sex toy, no. She is a human female who shall not be reduced to merely an object.
: How very progressive of you.
: You’re not going to tell me you’ve had sex in the music room too, are you? I’d ask Imani, but I think she’s just reached the stage where words no longer make any sense to her.
: Blehbbht.
: See?
: So you’ve never done it in the classroom either, huh?
: Is that the answer you’re locking in?
: It’s gotta be the sex toy one. I’ve heard how much you visit the porn shop. There’s no way Maki’s let you leave that place without at least one free fleshlight.
: Ignore Rika. I’m locking in the classroom answer.
: Booooo! That’s-
: Wakana is correct. I have never had sex in a classroom.
: Ha! Get fucked, you sober cunt.
: That’s right. Get fucked, you sober cunt.
: Issomebody gonna walkme home againnn?
: We’re at the beach, Imani. You aren’t going home tonight. We’re sleeping at a fancy resort thingy. Remember?
: Blehbbht.
: Damn. I thought we had her back for a second.
: You guys need any more beer? I can go grab another 12-pack after I take Imani to a quieter room so she can rest.
: I’m fine. I’ve already achieved my mission of reaching inebriation. I can die happy now. Or, at the very least, just die in general.

: Unfortunately, completing your mission came at the cost of stealing my share of the alcohol. Which means I am not drunk at all when I probably should be so I can have an excuse for anything else that happens tonight.
: I can grab some for you, Akira. I don’t mind.
: No, it’s fine. I should probably be heading back to my room soon anyway.
: No, stay! This night’s just getting started, man.
: I’ve never gotten to come to the beach with you guys before. Which means we need to make up for lost time by hanging out until the sun rises.
: Oh, right. I suppose it is your first trip, isn’t it?
: Yes! And I have heard stories of how you look in your swimsuit, so I am very excited for when you are rested and recovered tomorrow to say the least.
: And who have you heard these stories from, exactly?
: The light music club. They worship you as a goddess over there.
: Good. I am one.
: Imaniiiiiiii...Take me hoooooome...
: Noooo. You’re Imani. I’m Rika.
: Hehehahah...Rika. Thassa fun name. Like Pikachu. Rikachu.
: Maybe next Christmalloween, okay? Come on.
: Don’t go anywhere, you two! I’ll be right back with more alcohol! Which I will not drink for both calorie-related reasons and also because I want to remember tonight!
: Bye-bye, Imani! I love yoooouuuu!
: Please get someone to watch her so she doesn’t choke on her vomit and die. Futaba will do it. She’s responsible.
: Any chance I get to see Futaba is a good one, so okay! Be right back!
: ...Is what I would say if I was not a liar!
: Enjoy being locked in there until morning, suckers. Operation: Jim Halpert is a go after all! I just needed to work alone this time!
: Go! Time! Sleep? Bed!
: Uhh...what are you guys doing?
: Wha...what are you two doing?! Shouldn’t you be in bed right now?!
: It’s only like 10:30. Why would we be asleep?
: Wow, really? Is that it? It felt way later.
: Is...Miss Imai okay? Do you...need help...taking her somewhere?
: She’s fine. Just steer clear of this room for the next twelve hours. Do you understand?
: Why? Did you trap Sensei and Miss Watabe in there in an effort to make them finally sleep together?

: Wha...no! You mean like in the eighth season of The Office where Jim and Cathy are forced to sleep in the same room and Jim needs to overcome temptation in order to progress?! That would be, like...so dumb!
: Okay...Because we would...probably be okay with avoiding the room if...that’s what was happening...
: But, since it’s not...
: Wait, hold on. Really?
: Oh, sure. Pretty much everybody in the light music club except Chika wants those two to sleep together. It’s kind of wild they haven’t yet.
: I see...
: Who are we talkin’ about?! I wanna join in!
: In that case, the two of you never saw anything. Understood?
: Loud and clear.
: Want us to stand guard?
: Could you? I need to get this one back to her room before she throws up on the carpet.
: Is it just me or has Rika been gone for a while now?
: She probably forgot which room we were in and gave up.
: Should I, like...go look for her something?
: Just text her. Phones exist for a reason.
: My phone’s in my room. Do you have yours?
: Rika took it so I wouldn’t be distracted during bar night.
: I’ll be right back then. I-
: Huh? That’s weird.
: The door is locked.
: From the outside? Amazing. I’m sure Rika had nothing to do with this at all and that this resort is merely just terrible when it comes to security and safety.
: So, what do we-
: Oh.
: I’m going to sleep.
: It’s clear she isn’t coming back and I’m too drunk and miserable to continue existing anyway.
: I see that didn’t stop you from taking the last few beers we had to your nightstand, though.
: I need them there in case I get thirsty in the middle of the night.
: Do you want to talk?
: No. I want to die.
: Me too, but we’re in this together. And we’d both be equally mad if the other died.
: I would dance on your grave and I have never once danced a day in my life.
: So, how’s Osako?
: Wonderful. It’s me who should not inhabit this planet anymore. And I am an idiot for believing we could face the future together.
: You’re not an idiot for proposing to the woman you’re in love with, Wakana. You’re an idiot for thinking you could get married considering Japan does not allow that.
: For what it’s worth, I did include that in the proposal. Just none of it matters anymore because we’re on a “break” and that’s just the adult way of saying we’re absolutely fucking fucked.
: Is she, like...living somewhere else then? Are you living somewhere else?
: We’re both still in the apartment. But she sleeps on the couch now since she’s trying to be nice and not damage my back.
: Frankly, I’d rather it just break. So dramatically and painfully, in fact, that the only thing doctors would be able to do for me is numb me permanently via euthanasia.
: You guys will figure it out, Wakana. You always do.
: No, Arakawa. We won’t. Not this time. This isn’t just some stupid fight or a misunderstanding.
: It’s a misalignment of ideals and desires and, more than anything, a testament to the fact that despite what we both want, we simply aren’t right for one another.
: Now, please excuse me as I pass out and dream of being crushed by the moon.
: You really think I’m going to let you sleep on that note?
: No. But could you at least turn the light off so the brightness no longer hurts my eyes?
: Have you taken your medication tonight? Whatever that medication is now.
: Yes, Arakawa. Why? Is someone paying you to be my nurse?
: I’m just worried about you. I’ve never seen you drink this much before and I feel like you’re just putting on a brave face right now since all of your friends are here.
: I was about to ask you exactly what your idea of a “brave face” means but then I remembered who I am talking to and realized you just have no clue at all.
: You’re giving up.
: At least I’m not crying.
: Do you want to?
: No, you fucking idiot. Who ever wants to cry? It feels bad, it makes your head hurt, it gives you congestion, and it makes you utterly hideous.
: I don’t mind seeing you when you’re hideous, you know.
: Then bust that god damn door down and get me something else to drink as my impending jaundice would likely please both of us right now.
: Is there anything I can actually do? That will help. Even if it’s just a little.
: Turn the lights off and put Gilmore Girls on the TV. I fucking hate the show, but they talk very quickly and it will distract me from my thoughts.
: Anything else?
: Not unless you know “She Walks in Beauty” by heart.
: She walks in beauty, like the night. Of cloudless climes and starry skies.
: Oh, now you’re suddenly letting the poetic side of you out again. Fantastic. Exceptional timing as always, Arakawa.
: And all that’s best of dark and bright meet in her aspect and her eyes.
: Stop. Upon reflection, I’ve realized you’re going to ruin that poem for me. I’d like to just lie here in silence instead, please.
: Sure. I’ll go set a futon up in the living room and leave you alone. Sorry for-
: Don’t leave me alone.
: What? But you-
: I want you with me right now. Sleep here instead.
: Uhh...
: Please?...
: This is...quite the 180 out of nowhere, I must admit.
: Arakawa, I only bicker like this with you because it brings me joy. You should know by now I mean very little of it.
: So when I tell you to leave, please just always assume I’m saying “Don’t go.”
: Now, if you’ll excuse me, I’m going to go back to pretending I hate you right now so I can trick myself into thinking things are normal when they very clearly are not.
: Wow. You’re really drunk if you’re just going to come out and be all cute like that.
: Can you pull the covers over me? I can’t move.
: Yes, Wakana.
: I can pull the covers over you.
Wakana’s affection has increased to [wakana_love]!
